page_title: HEI 2-0 STU | Heidenheim v Stuttgart 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Florian Badstubner has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+4' 2 - 0 Sensational goal, a once in a lifetime shot. Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) spots the goalkeeper off his line and decides to shoot from 50 metres out. The keeper tries desperately to stop the ball but it hits the back of the net.
90+3' A great pass puts Luca Raimund (VfB Stuttgart) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
90+1' Here is a change. Eren Dinkci is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste is given a rest as he is replaced by Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Lilian Egloff (VfB Stuttgart) trips an opposition player and Florian Badstubner signals a foul.
87' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
86' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing. Stuttgart have a corner.
86' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Stuttgart are going to take it.
85' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
84' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
83' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Florian Badstubner ignores the protests.
82' The substitution is prepared. Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Norman Theuerkauf.
81' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Adrian Beck will be replaced by Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim).
80' That's the end of the game for Atakan Karazor, who is replaced by Lilian Egloff (VfB Stuttgart).
79' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

79' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Stuttgart can continue in their attacking effort.
78' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Hiroki Ito is replaced by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
75' It is time for a substitution. Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) is on for Anthony Rouault.
74' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Florian Badstubner pulls out a yellow card.
74' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
72' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) comes close as his long-range free kick goes a whisker wide of the right post.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Woo-Yeong Jeong departs the field of play to be replaced by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
71' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Silas and he is replaced by Luca Raimund (VfB Stuttgart).
70' 1 - 0 Gooal! Jan-Niklas Beste takes over corner duties. Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 1:0.
70' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner.
68' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
67' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
65' It looks like Dan-Axel Zagadou (VfB Stuttgart) saw red with that tackle. Florian Badstubner won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
63' 14:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
57' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) doesn't keep his cool and fails to convert the penalty. He skies the ball way over the bar and into the stands.
56' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) is going to take the penalty!
56' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Stuttgart!
56' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) is able to continue to play.
53' Looks like Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
51' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
49' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
44' A yellow card for a tackle by Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim). Florian Badstubner doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
44' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
43' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
42' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
40' Flag up against Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
39' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.
38' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a brilliant effort from the free kick, but the ball crashes against the bar. What a chance!
37' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. Stuttgart are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
34' The corner kick from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

33' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Heidenheim.
33' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

33' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

32' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
30' The resulting corner from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) comes to nothing.

29' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.

25' Direct free kick. Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to beat the opposition's defence with a fine lofted pass into the penalty box, but one of the defenders reacts well and averts the threat.
24' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down. Florian Badstubner has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Stuttgart will take a free kick.
23' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart).
20' Stuttgart control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
17' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
16' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

16' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
15' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Florian Badstubner no option but to blow his whistle.
12' Kevin Muller blocks a long-range effort from Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) towards the bottom right corner.
8' Stuttgart fail to score from a corner as Kevin Muller (Heidenheim) leaps to collect the ball.
6' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
5' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Stuttgart will kick-off.
Florian Badstubner was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
